anchorAcc().details: Alias of `acc`: the contribution accumulator IS the contributions instance's lane-2      log, read by `MerkleSnapshot.trigger()` at each epoch boundary.

bindSnapshot(address).details: A post-deploy call rather than a constructor argument because of the deployment      cycle: the snapshot's constructor takes the accumulator, so the accumulator must      exist first. Same shape as the contributions `TrustAccumulatorMirror.bindSnapshot`.      The `accumulator()` read-back is defence in depth: it turns a mistyped binding — the      one irreversible mistake available here — into a revert. It also fixes the ordering      during pre-checkpoint wiring: deploy the new accumulator, call the snapshot's      constitutional `setAccumulator`, THEN bind. Once any checkpoint exists,      `MerkleSnapshot` forbids re-pointing; recovery uses a new snapshot and vault migration.

checkpoint().details: Only the bound snapshot may mint, so every checkpoint id lands on the contract-fixed      epoch boundary with both lanes frozen and its `paramsHash` pinned. The accumulator does      not reject an unchanged lane here: `MerkleSnapshot.trigger()` is the only caller and      must decide freshness across BOTH lanes. A strict off-chain append legitimately needs      a new checkpoint while this lane remains byte-identical.

returns.id: The new checkpoint id (also its index).

params._schemaAdmin: The address allowed to set the schema allowlist once (the deployer in        practice: schema UIDs depend on this resolver's address, so they cannot be known at        construction — registration must happen after deployment).

returns._0: Whether the resolver supports ETH transfers.

params.values: Explicit ETH amounts which were sent with each attestation.

returns._0: Whether all the attestations are valid.

params.attestations: The existing attestations to be revoked.
params.values: Explicit ETH amounts which were sent with each revocation.

returns._0: Whether the attestations can be revoked.

params.attestation: The existing attestation to be revoked.

returns._0: Whether the attestation can be revoked.
Semver contract version as a string.

anchorAcc().notice: The running anchor fold (`keccak256(abi.encode(prev, leaf))`, acc_0 = 0).

anchorCount().notice: Number of anchors folded so far.

attest((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint64,ui.notice: Processes an attestation and verifies whether it's valid.

bindSnapshot(address).notice: One-shot: bind the `MerkleSnapshot` whose `trigger()` may mint checkpoints here.

binder().notice: The deployer, and the only address that may perform the one-shot `bindSnapshot`.

checkpoint().notice: Freeze the current accumulator as a new checkpoint. Permissionless.

isPayable().notice: Checks if the resolver can be sent ETH.

leafCount().notice: The number of edges folded so far.

multiAttest((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint.notice: Processes multiple attestations and verifies whether they are valid.

multiRevoke((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint.notice: Processes revocation of multiple attestation and verifies they can be revoked.

revoke((bytes32,bytes32,uint64,uint64,ui.notice: Processes an attestation revocation and verifies if it can be revoked.

schemaAdmin().notice: The only address that may call `setSchemas` (one shot; see `schemasSet`).

schemasSet().notice: Whether the schema allowlist has been set (it can only ever be set once).

setSchemas(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Set the schema allowlist. Callable exactly once, only by `schemaAdmin`. Until this         is called every attestation reverts, so no edge with an untrusted kind tag can ever         enter the accumulator.

snapshot().notice: The only address allowed to mint checkpoints: the `MerkleSnapshot` whose         `trigger()` freezes this lane. Set once, via `bindSnapshot`.

version().notice: Returns the full semver contract version.
